VERSION 3.26.0.68

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        REPLACE penThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal penThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
        REPLACE eraserThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal eraserThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/common/Values.qml
    IMPORT xofm.libs.toolbar 1.0
    TRAVERSE Item
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var mPenThicknessModel: {
                const stockContext = 'xofm::libs::toolbar::PenThicknessModel';
                const stockThin = qsTranslate(stockContext, 'Thin');
                const language = stockThin === 'Fin'
                    ? 'fr'
                    : stockThin === 'Schmal'
                        ? 'de'
                        : stockThin === 'Fino'
                            ? 'es'
                            : 'en';
                const labelsByLanguage = {
                    en: [
                        'Thinner (0.5)',
                        'Thin (1)',
                        'Medium Thin (1.5)',
                        'Medium (2)',
                        'Medium Thick (2.5)',
                        'Thick (3)',
                        'Thicker (5)',
                        'Even Thicker (8)',
                        "Can't Go Thicker (100)",
                    ],
                    fr: [
                        'Plus fin (0.5)',
                        'Fin (1)',
                        'Moyen-fin (1.5)',
                        'Moyen (2)',
                        'Moyen-épais (2.5)',
                        'Épais (3)',
                        'Plus épais (5)',
                        'Très épais (8)',
                        'Pas plus épais ! (100)',
                    ],
                    de: [
                        'Dünner (0.5)',
                        'Dünn (1)',
                        'Mitteldünn (1.5)',
                        'Mittel (2)',
                        'Mitteldick (2.5)',
                        'Dick (3)',
                        'Dicker (5)',
                        'Sehr dick (8)',
                        "Dicker geht's nicht (100)",
                    ],
                    es: [
                        'Más fino (0.5)',
                        'Fino (1)',
                        'Medio fino (1.5)',
                        'Medio (2)',
                        'Medio grueso (2.5)',
                        'Grueso (3)',
                        'Más grueso (5)',
                        'Muy grueso (8)',
                        '¡No puede ser más grueso! (100)',
                    ],
                };
                const labels = labelsByLanguage[language] ?? labelsByLanguage.en;
                const iterable = [
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thin',
                        thickness: 0.5,
                        displayName: labels[0],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thin',
                        thickness: 1,
                        displayName: labels[1],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_medium',
                        thickness: 1.5,
                        displayName: labels[2],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_medium',
                        thickness: 2,
                        displayName: labels[3],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_medium',
                        thickness: 2.5,
                        displayName: labels[4],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thick',
                        thickness: 3,
                        displayName: labels[5],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thick',
                        thickness: 5,
                        displayName: labels[6],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thick',
                        thickness: 8,
                        displayName: labels[7],
                    },
                    {
                        iconPath: 'qrc:/ark/icons/stroke_thick',
                        thickness: 100,
                        displayName: labels[8],
                    },
                ];
                iterable.isValidThickness = () => true;
                iterable.nameForThickness = e => iterable.find(z => z.thickness === e)?.displayName ?? '';
                iterable.iconForThickness = e => iterable.find(z => z.thickness === e)?.iconPath ?? '';
                iterable.translationContext = () => 'MoreStrokeSizes';
                iterable.thicknessAt = e => iterable[e].thickness;
                iterable.defaultThickness = () => iterable[1];
                return iterable;
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/WritingTool.qml
    IMPORT common 1.0
    TRAVERSE PenTool
        REMOVE PenThicknessModel
        REPLACE penThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal penThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
        TRAVERSE ArkControls.FoldoutGrid > Repeater[.model=thicknessModel] > ArkControls.FoldoutItem
            REPLACE thickness WITH { required property var thickness }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
    REBUILD PenTool
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        REPLACE { thicknessModel } WITH STREAM /Values.mPenThicknessModel/
    END REBUILD
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/EraserMenu.qml
    IMPORT common 1.0
    TRAVERSE PenTool
        REMOVE PenThicknessModel
        REPLACE eraserThicknessSelected WITH {
            signal eraserThicknessSelected(thickness : var)
        }
        TRAVERSE ColumnLayout > ArkControls.FoldoutGrid > Repeater[.model=thicknessModel] > ArkControls.FoldoutItem
            REPLACE thickness WITH { required property var thickness }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
    REBUILD PenTool
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        REPLACE { thicknessModel } WITH STREAM /Values.mPenThicknessModel/
    END REBUILD
END AFFECT
